purpose: Non-admission discovery of official Météo-France weather station instrumentation and siting metadata relevant to verifying actual 3-second wind-gust observations in the Windstorm Europe hazard model.

entries.name: Meteo-France station information sheets: siting, location history and instrument metadata
entries.spatial_scope: France mainland and overseas station metadata; exact instrument coverage and site-vintage vary per station
entries.temporal_scope: Official public catalogue shown updated in September 2026; each station PDF carries its own opening/closure/site history
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Individual station PDF sheet listing position, successive locations, opening and closure dates, site quality, measured parameters, sensor/instrument descriptions and station photos; one PDF is not one meteorological hourly sample
entries.note: Official Météo-France publisher description covers station positions, successive site placements, opening/closure, site quality, measurement classes, instrumentation and photos. Portal displays about 15,184 publicly listed PDF resources, NOT a validated count of unique physical measurement sites or historic independent stations. No station PDF original bytes or SHA-256 were acquired in this pass. Pin exact station IDs and PDF vintage, original bytes, site class and instrument changes before independent FXI3S vs CLIMK/ERA5/C3S validation; matched measurements remain external and the recorded station PDFs do not imply insurable event-loss evidence.
